published_source: Authors' code re-run in Stata MP 16 (work copy ~/did_packages/_work/mnsc.2022.02057/stata/run_all.do; outreg2 export lines commented out because outreg2 is not installed). No article text or PDF is in the project, so the published value is the authors' code output on the shipped data. Table 7A column (1).
notes: Table 7A column (1): U.S. sanctions and technology decoupling, IPC three-digit class x year, 2007-2018 (123 classes, 1,343 rows, unbalanced: 86 classes in 2007, 119 in 2018). Authors: reg decoupling post_sanction n_pat_c n_pat_u i.year, absorb(IPC) vce(robust). Controls (time-varying, class-year): n_pat_c = log Chinese patents, n_pat_u = log U.S. patents; the controls rule is the only 5c violation. post_sanction = 1 if the class had been exposed to U.S. sanctions before that year. Cohorts: 2014 (IPC 54, 60, 124) and 2015 (IPC 107, 123) have untreated and treated rows; 2007 (IPC 106, 111, 121) are treated in every sample year (always-treated, 36 rows); 115 classes never treated. Switch-off: IPC 60 is treated in 2014 only (sequence 000000010000); run_spec drops its 2015-2018 rows (4 rows) per Hull fn 6, so the run_spec TWFE differs slightly from the authors' coefficient. SE deviation: authors report heteroskedasticity-robust SEs; run_spec clusters by IPC (project convention for robust-SE papers). Point estimates unaffected. Data: t7a_panel.rds = Table_7A_Data.dta as shipped plus g_first and always_tr flags (prep_controls.R).
